mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing new electrical outlets or lighting fixtures in an existing bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for installing new electrical outlets or lighting fixtures in an existing bathroom typically begins with a thorough assessment of your current electrical system and structural limitations. Our team will identify the best locations for new wiring, considering both aesthetics and safety codes. This often involves carefully opening walls or ceilings to run new lines, installing junction boxes, and then patching and finishing the surfaces. For Frasheski Construction, our process includes detailed planning to minimize disruption and ensure all new installations meet local building codes and safety standards, especially important in the diverse housing stock of the East Bay.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves assessing the existing system, running new wiring through walls or ceilings, installing fixtures, and then finishing surfaces, all while adhering to safety codes.
